definitions.explanation: A person or thing that perfectly represents a particular type or category.

examples.japanese: これは{日本|にほん}{家屋|かおく}の{典型|てんけい}だ。
examples.english: This is a typical Japanese house.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{典型的|てんけいてき}なサラリーマンだ。
examples.english: He is a typical company employee.

examples.japanese: {典型的|てんけいてき}な{間違|まちが}いを{避|さ}ける。

notes:
{典型|てんけい} means a typical example or archetype — something that perfectly represents a particular type or category. Most commonly encountered in the adjectival form {典型的|てんけいてき}(な).

COMMON FORMS:
- {典型的|てんけいてき}な〜: typical ~, classic ~ (na-adjective, very common)
- 〜の{典型|てんけい}: a typical example of ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {典型的|てんけいてき}な{例|れい}: typical example
- {典型的|てんけいてき}な{日本人|にほんじん}: typical Japanese person
- {典型的|てんけいてき}な{症状|しょうじょう}: typical symptoms
- {典型的|てんけいてき}な{間違|まちが}い: typical mistake

USAGE NOTE:
{典型的|てんけいてき} can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context. Saying someone is a {典型的|てんけいてき}なサラリーマン may imply they are stereotypically conventional.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}: representative, exemplary (more positive)
- {標準的|ひょうじゅんてき}: standard, normal
